description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to network information, including routing tables, network adapters, and IP address iterators within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes class definitions for RoutingTable, AdapterObserver, IPV4AddressIterator, IPV6AddressIterator, and AdapterIterator, along with associated methods and data members.

classes.name: RoutingTable
classes.description: Represents a routing table, supporting IPv4 or IPv6, containing a list of Route entries.

classes.name: RoutingTable::Route
classes.description: Represents a network route with source, destination, gateway, and other routing parameters.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Observes network adapter events and provides notifications.

classes.name: AdapterObserver::INotification
classes.description: Interface for receiving adapter events such as Event, Added, and Removed.

classes.name: IPV4AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterates over IPv4 addresses associated with a network adapter or list.

classes.name: IPV6AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterates over IPv6 addresses associated with a network adapter or list.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterates over network adapters, providing access to their properties such as name, MAC address, and IP addresses.

methods.name: RoutingTable::Route::Interface
methods.description: Returns the interface name associated with the route.

methods.name: AdapterObserver::Open
methods.description: Opens the adapter observer to start receiving notifications.

methods.name: IPV4AddressIterator::Address
methods.description: Returns the current IP address in the iteration.

methods.name: IPV6AddressIterator::Address
methods.description: Returns the current IP address in the iteration.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the current network adapter.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::MACAddress
methods.description: Returns the MAC address of the current network adapter as a string.
